description: A state-of-the-art claim is made without running the stronger baselines named in related work.

inputs.label: Evaluation plan
inputs.content:
We evaluate our urban heat model against nearest-neighbour interpolation only.

Our related work section discusses kriging, gradient-boosted regression and the
physics-based UrbClim model as the standard approaches for urban heat mapping, and
notes that gradient-boosted regression is the closest prior work to ours.

We claim our model achieves state-of-the-art accuracy for urban heat prediction.

signals.name: connects the gap to the state-of-the-art claim
